title: van der Waals one-dimensional atomic crystal heterostructure derived from carbon nanotubes
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,5619-5656
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00670D, Review Article
Yunfei Li, Ziyi Hu, Qing Guo, Jing Li, Shuai Liu, Xiaoxuan Xie, Xu Zhang, Lixing Kang, Qingwen Li
This review highlights recent advances in one-dimensional van der Waals heterojunctions using CNTs as growth templates, covering construction methods, selection criteria, and unique properties/applications from interfacial interactions.
